steps.en: Install the library and set the judge model's API key
steps.zh: 装上库，配好评审模型的 API key

steps.en: Run your RAG app on test questions; keep each question, answer and retrieved passages
steps.zh: 用测试问题跑一遍 RAG 应用，记下每条的问题、回答和检索到的段落

steps.en: Pick metrics and a judge LLM, then call evaluate on the dataset
steps.zh: 选好指标和评审模型，对数据集调用 evaluate

steps.en: For each answer, has the judge list its claims and check each against the retrieved passages
steps.zh: 对每条回答，让评审模型列出其中的论断，逐条对照检索段落核对

steps.en: Turns the verdicts into 0–1 scores per sample and per metric
steps.zh: 把判定折算成分数：每条样本、每个指标一个 0 到 1 的数

value.en: Each pipeline change comes with numbers for grounding and retrieval instead of a hand-read sample
value.zh: 每次改动检索链路，都有“回答是否有据”“检索是否找全”的分数，而不是手翻几条
